ko: [Dialog(head="char_349_chiave", delay=0.5)]요즘 갑자기 흥미가 생겼어. 레시피가 꽤 재밌던데, 한번 해보고 싶어.
[Dialog(head="char_349_chiave", delay=0.5)]이 혁신적인 염국 요리를 봐. 이름이 무려 '마파딸기'야.
[Dialog(head="char_346_aosta", delay=0.5)]이 책을 절대 염국 오퍼레이터가 보게 해서는 안 됩니다.
[Dialog(head="char_346_aosta", delay=0.5)]브로카, 끈 좀 줘봐요. 키아베를 묶어 버리게.
[Dialog(head="char_346_aosta", delay=0.5)]라테라노 성당을 찾아 던져버리죠. 수도사들이 아주 두들겨 패게요.
en: [Dialog(head="char_349_chiave", delay=0.5)]What? Don't give me that, I'm a...
[Dialog(head="char_349_chiave", delay=0.5)]I kinda got into it recently, and this cookbook's real interesting. I wanna give it a shot.
[Dialog(head="char_346_aosta", delay=0.5)]'Innovations in the Cuisine of Terra, Issue 200.'
[Dialog(head="char_346_aosta", delay=0)]Don't know if you should trust that in your kitchen.
[Dialog(head="char_349_chiave", delay=0.5)]Check out this new dish from Yan! 'Mapo Strawberry.'
[Dialog(head="char_346_aosta", delay=0.5)]Don't you ever let a single Yanese operator catch sight of this thing.
[Dialog(head="char_349_chiave", delay=0.5)]I've decided. I'm gonna learn this one.
[Dialog(head="char_346_aosta", delay=0.5)]Broca. Get a rope. Tie Chiave up.
[Dialog(head="char_349_chiave", delay=1)]Waargh! What are you two doing?!
[Dialog(head="char_346_aosta", delay=0.5)]Find a Laterano church. Throw him in there. Let the clerics beat his brains out.
ja: [Title] MAIN_LOG_102_1
[Div] Part.03
[Dialog(head="char_356_broca", delay=1)]お前、本を読んでるのか？
[Dialog(head="char_349_chiave", delay=0.5)]なんだよ、俺様だって本くらい……
[Dialog(head="char_346_aosta", delay=1)]それは何です……レシピ本？
[Dialog(head="char_346_aosta", delay=0)]料理を学ぶつもりですか？
[Dialog(head="char_349_chiave", delay=0.5)]最近急に興味が湧いてきてな……このレシピ本見てると、面白くて試してみたくなる料理がいっぱいあるんだ。
[Dialog(head="char_346_aosta", delay=0.5)]『革新的テラグルメ第200号』。
[Dialog(head="char_346_aosta", delay=0)]あてにならなそうですね。
[Dialog(head="char_349_chiave", delay=0.5)]見てみろよ、この革新的な炎国料理。「マーポーイチゴ」だってよ。
[Dialog(head="char_356_broca", delay=1)]このバカが……
[Dialog(head="char_346_aosta", delay=0.5)]くれぐれも炎国のオペレーターには見せないでくださいね。
[Dialog(head="char_349_chiave", delay=0.5)]決めた、まずはこれから試してみるぜ。
[Dialog(head="char_349_chiave", delay=1)]シエスタ風フルーツピザ。
[Dialog(head="char_356_broca", delay=1.5)]......
[Dialog(head="char_346_aosta", delay=1.5)]......
[Dialog(head="char_349_chiave", delay=1.5)]......
[Dialog(head="char_346_aosta", delay=0.5)]ブローカ、縄を探してキアーベを縛り上げてください。
[Dialog(head="char_356_broca", delay=0.5)]ああ。
[Dialog(head="char_356_broca", delay=1)]動くなよ、キアーベ。
[Dialog(head="char_349_chiave", delay=1)]うわっ、何すんだてめぇら！？
[Dialog(head="char_356_broca", delay=2)]……次は？
[Dialog(head="char_346_aosta", delay=0.5)]ラテラーノの教会にぶち込んで、修道士たちにキツいお灸をすえてもらいましょう。
[Dialog(head="char_356_broca", delay=0.5)]ああ。
[Dialog(head="char_349_chiave", delay=1.5)]んでだよ！？
